source: https://enterjamaica.gov.jm/?language=en-US live C5 HTML, read 2026-08-30. The public HTML exposes field labels and required attributes, minlength=6 on the email-verification input, maxlength=4 on Flight #, and the Travel Date (mm/dd/yyyy) prompt. No text-field regexes or complete official error set is claimed, and no local validator is mounted.

email.label: Email verification
email.help: The portal requires email verification before the C5 form opens and sends confirmation after submission.

last_name.label: Last Name
last_name.help: Copy the family name from the passport.

first_name.label: First Name
first_name.help: Copy the first name from the passport.

middle_name.label: Middle Name
middle_name.placeholder: As shown in the passport, if any
middle_name.help: The live HTML does not mark this input required.

birth_date.label: Birth Date
birth_date.help: The form says to enter it as it appears on the passport. No text regex is published.

gender.label: Gender
gender.help: Use the option matching the passport details.

family_members.label: Family Members with you
family_members.help: Choose the number travelling with you; the public select lists 0 through 5.

home_address.label: Home Address
home_address.placeholder: Street, city, region, postal code, country
home_address.help: The live form separates the home address into these five parts.

occupation.label: Occupation
occupation.help: Use a short current occupation description.

passport_number.label: Passport Number
passport_number.help: Use the passport carried for the trip. The page publishes no number pattern or length.

passport_issue_country.label: Country of Issue
passport_issue_country.help: This is the issuing country, not the country of residence.

jamaica_address.label: Address in Jamaica
jamaica_address.help: Enter the actual first stay address shown in the booking or host details.

countries_visited.label: Countries visited
countries_visited.help: Use the multi-select on the live form for the requested travel-history answer.

flight_number.label: Flight number
flight_number.help: The public HTML sets maxlength=4 for the number portion after the airline selector.

departure_port.label: Departure Port
departure_port.help: Enter the port from which this flight or vessel reaches Jamaica.

travel_date.label: Travel Date
travel_date.help: The official input is read-only and shows Travel Date (mm/dd/yyyy). Use its date picker.

visit_purpose.label: Purpose of visit
visit_purpose.placeholder: Vacation, business, transit, resident or another listed purpose
visit_purpose.help: Select the option matching this trip.

stay_length.label: Length of Stay
stay_length.help: The live form asks for length of stay in days.

luggage_counts.label: Number of pieces of luggage
luggage_counts.help: Report checked and hand luggage separately from luggage sent by air or sea freight.

customs_declaration.label: Customs declaration questions
customs_declaration.help: Declare restricted goods, currency, commercial goods and items above the allowance. If in doubt, declare them to the customs officer.
